part.name: Orthogonal dual-rail clamp and pivot assembly
part.description: Three-solid mechanical assembly consisting of two crossing hollow D-profile rails, a pair of opposing rounded-square clamp plates, and coaxial central bosses/pin. The rails cross at the origin in the same general plane, with one rail vertical and the other diagonal in the supplied front view. The clamp plates capture the rail intersection from opposite sides and the central cylindrical interface locates the assembly.
part.symmetry_note: The assembly is approximately symmetric about the rail mid-plane y=6.35 mm. The clamp plates form an opposing front/rear pair, while the vertical rail is symmetric about x=0 and the diagonal rail is approximately symmetric about the origin along its own axis. Local transition cuts and openings interrupt exact symmetry.

Section.name: Diagonal hollow rail
features included: D-shaped or rounded rectangular outer profile
Outer end interface with bore opening
Small central locating or clearance openings
Section.function intent: Provides a long structural arm and attachment interface across the diagonal axis while passing through the central clamp assembly.
Section.physical behavior: The broad planar walls resist bending, the rounded outer wall and edge radii reduce stress concentration, and the longitudinal bore reduces mass while retaining bending stiffness. The central reliefs provide clearance for the crossing rail and clamp hardware.
Section.geometry: A long, constant-thickness hollow rail extending along an oblique x-z axis. Its section combines broad planar walls, a large-radius rounded side, longitudinal fillets, and a smaller coaxial internal cylindrical bore. The profile is locally trimmed and blended near the center.
Section.location: Crosses the part center from negative x/negative z to positive x/positive z; appears lower-left to upper-right in the front view.

Section.name: Vertical hollow rail
features included: D-shaped or rounded rectangular outer profile
Upper and lower longitudinal bore segments
Bored upper and lower end interfaces
Section.function intent: Provides the second principal structural arm and establishes the vertical axis of the assembly through the central clamp.
Section.physical behavior: The hollow section carries axial and bending loads with reduced mass. Opposed broad walls provide directional stiffness, rounded side walls reduce edge stress, and the central relief accommodates the intersecting diagonal rail and central pin.
Section.geometry: A straight hollow rail aligned with the global z-axis. It has broad planar front and rear walls, large-radius cylindrical side walls, small longitudinal bore surfaces, planar end caps, and blended local cutouts around the center.
Section.location: Runs from the bottom to the top of the part through the central intersection.

Section.name: Front clamp plate
features included: Recessed shoulder around the inner region
Section.function intent: Forms the front jaw of the central clamp, protects the rail intersection, and distributes clamping force over a broad area.
Section.physical behavior: The broad inner face reacts compressive load against the rails, while the thick perimeter and rounded corners resist local bending and spread stress. The central opening and boss interface locate the plate relative to the clamp axis.
Section.geometry: A thick rounded-square plate on the positive-y side. It has a large outer plane, a recessed inner plane, straight side facets, quarter-cylindrical corner patches, and a stepped shoulder between outer and inner outlines.
Section.location: Centered on the rail intersection on the front or positive-y side of the assembly.

Section.name: Rear clamp plate
features included: Recessed shoulder around the inner region
Section.function intent: Forms the rear jaw of the clamp and reacts the load applied by the front plate, capturing and stabilizing the crossing rails.
Section.physical behavior: The rear plate carries compressive reaction loads from the front plate and central fastener. Its broad inner face limits local contact pressure, and the stepped, rounded perimeter increases bending rigidity while avoiding sharp stress risers.
Section.geometry: A thick rounded-square plate on the negative-y side, geometrically paired with the front plate. It includes outer and inner planes, straight perimeter facets, cylindrical corner bands, and an intermediate shoulder.
Section.location: Centered on the rail intersection on the back or negative-y side of the assembly.

Section.name: Central bosses and pivot pin
Section.function intent: Aligns the two clamp plates and crossing rails about a common center, provides the principal fastening or pivot axis, and transfers clamp load between the opposing plates.
Section.physical behavior: The central cylinder reacts shear and bearing loads while the larger-radius bosses spread axial compression into the clamp plates. Coaxial cylindrical contact constrains translation normal to the plates and may permit controlled rotation if the fastener is not fully locked.
Section.geometry: A coaxial cylindrical stack centered at x=0 and z=0. It contains a central radius-6.35 mm cylinder spanning the rail thickness, larger radius-9.525 mm boss surfaces outside the rail envelope, and planar annular seating faces.
Section.location: At the exact center of the assembly, aligned with the global y-axis through both clamp plates and both rails.
